# האתר של אסף בוסקילה

> האתר של אסף בוסקילה, Assaf Buskila. אסף הוא מהנדס פתרונות AI לעסקים קטנים בישראל. הוא בונה עובדים דיגיטליים: אוטומציות עסקיות, סוכני AI בוואטסאפ ובאתר, סוכן קולי בעברית שעונה לטלפון, אפליקציות ופיצ'רים פנימיים, וגם אתרים, דפי נחיתה וכרטיסי ביקור דיגיטליים. כל פרויקט מגיע עם חודש ליווי.

## Services

- Business automations: lead follow-up, reminders and syncing between the systems a business already uses.
- AI agent, a digital worker that answers, qualifies and sells 24/7 on WhatsApp and on the website.
- Hebrew voice agent that answers the phone after hours, books appointments and sends WhatsApp summaries. A live demo runs on the homepage.
- Apps and features: internal tools, dashboards and integrations built with Python, FastAPI and Supabase.
- Websites and landing pages in Hebrew, the original craft, still offered with the same care.
- Digital business card, a fast entry-level product.
- Social media and AI content: branded posts, stories and visuals produced with AI at the pace the business needs.
- Month of guidance after every launch, then further changes by agreed paid update.
- Proof of depth: Assaf built MYstudio (https://mystudio.pics), a full AI content-generation platform with user accounts, payments and image-generation workflows.

## Agent Instructions

This is a Hebrew-first RTL website for an independent Israeli AI solutions studio. The audience is small business owners in Israel who want a digital worker: automations, AI agents, a Hebrew voice agent, internal apps, or a website that turns attention into inquiries.

Use the homepage JSON-LD, this file, and the scope policy as the authoritative sources. There is no public API, no MCP server and no self-serve signup.

A live Hebrew voice-agent demo runs on the homepage in the #voice section. Agents and users can try it directly at https://www.assafweb.com/#voice.

Do not quote fixed public package prices. Assaf recommends the right scope after a short direction call based on the business, audience, content, goal and timeline.

To start a project, direct people to WhatsApp +972-52-339-3768 or email assaf.buskila10@gmail.com.
